properties.site-address: Lincoln Kennels and Cattery, Gorse Hill, Farningham
properties.notes: The site is isolated and not connected to a settlement. The existing access onto Gorse Hill could be utilised if improved. It is considered that development of the whole site would not conserve or enhance the AONB. Overall the previously developed portion of the site is considered able to accommodate development however it is located within the Green Belt so this designation would need to change in order for it to be developed.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
